title: Fix flaky ENOTEMPTY teardown in local-disk-gate-partial test: cancelAllDownloads resolves before downloader file work settles
description: tests/local-disk-gate-partial.test.cjs (MPI-756) test.after fails ENOTEMPTY on Windows ~1 in 3 runs. Find why cancelAllDownloads() returns before FileDownloader fs work ends; root-cause fix.
